description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of child nodes (tree width) and the accuracy@1 (%) for the GPT-4o model, with data points shown for both a solid blue line and a dashed light blue line. The x-axis, labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)," is scaled linearly from 1 to 7, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)," is also linear, ranging from 15 to 35, with major gridlines at intervals of 5. The solid blue line, representing GPT-4o, begins at a value of 24.4% when the number of child nodes is 1, increases to 28.9% at 3 nodes, peaks at 34.4% at 5 nodes, and then decreases to 31.1% at 7 nodes. The dashed light blue line starts at 26.7% for 1 node, rises to a peak of 27.8% at 3 nodes, and then steadily declines to 24.4% at 5 nodes and further to 20.0% at 7 nodes.
